title: Dashboard spec
description: The JSON document Computer writes to describe a dashboard. The renderer turns it into a single self-contained HTML file. Each entry in widgets is validated against that widget's own schema in widgets/<type>/schema.json.

title.description: Dashboard title in sentence case, no trailing period. Say what and when, e.g. "Cedar Valley account review, Q3 2026".

subtitle.description: Optional one-line context: who it is for, scope, or filters applied.

data_as_of.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with offset for when the data was queried, e.g. "2026-10-12T09:14:00-06:00". Shown prominently because dashboards are snapshots.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used by every currency value on the dashboard.

sources.description: Systems the data came from, e.g. ["DevRev", "Business Central"]. Shown in the footer.

widgets.description: Widgets in reading order: left to right, top to bottom on a 12-column grid.
